_comment: The places, checked in November 2026 against their own pages and the press. 地点，2026年11月对照各家官网和媒体报道核实。

items.name: Barbican Centre
items.subtitle: Arts centre with gallery
items.subtitleZh: 综合艺术中心与美术馆
items.why: A Brutalist arts complex in the City with an art gallery, cinemas, a library and free-to-enter foyers. Go for the gallery's big exhibitions, then wander the terraces; the conservatory opens only on listed dates with free timed tickets.
items.whyZh: 位于伦敦金融城的粗野主义艺术综合体，设有美术馆、电影院、图书馆和可免费进入的大堂。可先看美术馆的大型展览，再去露台逛逛；温室只在指定日期开放，需预约免费限时票。
items.hours: Art Gallery: Tue–Wed 10:00–18:00, Thu–Fri 10:00–20:00, Sat–Sun 10:00–18:00; closed Mon and bank holidays. Building: Mon–Fri 08:00–23:00, Sat–Sun 09:00–23:00, bank holidays 11:00–23:00
items.price: Free to enter the building; Art Gallery exhibitions are ticketed
items.priceZh: 大楼可免费进入；美术馆展览需购票
items.note: Last gallery entry is one hour before closing. Gallery shop opens an hour after the gallery.
items.noteZh: 美术馆最后入场为闭馆前一小时。商店比美术馆晚一小时开门。

items.name: Cutty Sark
items.subtitle: Historic clipper ship
items.why: A restored nineteenth-century tea clipper in a dry dock at Greenwich that you can board and explore from deck to hold. It is a maritime heritage visit rather than an art one, but it sits beside the Greenwich museums and the river.
items.whyZh: 格林威治干船坞里的十九世纪茶叶快船，修复后可登船，从甲板一路参观到货舱。它属于航海遗产而非艺术，但紧邻格林威治的各家博物馆和泰晤士河。
items.note: Book online ahead to be sure of entry.
items.noteZh: 建议提前网上订票以确保入场。

items.name: Museum of the Home
items.subtitle: Museum of domestic life
items.why: A free museum in restored almshouses on Kingsland Road, walking visitors through English living rooms from the 1600s to today. There is also a garden in the grounds.
items.whyZh: 位于金斯兰路修复后的济贫院建筑中的免费博物馆，带你走过从十七世纪至今的英国客厅。院内还有花园。
items.hours: Tue–Sun 10:00–17:00; Mon closed except bank holidays (10:00–17:00)
items.hoursZh: 周二至周日 10:00–17:00；周一闭馆，公共假日周一 10:00–17:00 开放
items.note: Closed on Mondays except bank holidays; check before a holiday visit.
items.noteZh: 周一闭馆（公共假日除外）；假期前往请先确认。

items.name: Orleans House Gallery
items.subtitle: Free public gallery
items.why: A free public gallery in a house in Twickenham, near the river, with changing exhibitions of art and sculpture. It suits a day out with a walk through the gardens.
items.whyZh: 特威克纳姆一栋宅邸里的免费公立美术馆，靠近泰晤士河，定期更换绘画与雕塑展览。适合配合花园散步安排一次出游。
items.hours: Tue–Sun 10:00–17:00 (last entry 16:45); closed Mon except bank holiday Mondays
items.hoursZh: 周二至周日 10:00–17:00（最后入场 16:45）；周一闭馆，公共假日周一除外

items.name: South London Gallery
items.subtitle: Free contemporary gallery
items.why: A free public gallery on Peckham Road with a steady programme of exhibitions by contemporary artists from Britain and abroad. Open late on Wednesdays.
items.whyZh: 位于佩卡姆路的免费公立美术馆，持续举办英国及国际当代艺术家的展览。周三开放至晚上9点。

items.name: Tate Britain
items.subtitle: National gallery of British art
items.why: Tate's riverside gallery for British art from the sixteenth century to today, with free entry to the collection displays. Special exhibitions are ticketed.
items.whyZh: 泰特旗下临河的英国艺术馆，收藏从十六世纪到当代的英国艺术，馆藏陈列免费参观。特别展览需购票。
items.price: Free entry to the collection; exhibitions usually need a booked ticket
items.priceZh: 馆藏陈列免费；特别展览通常需预订门票
items.note: The Millbank entrance is closed until 2027; use the Manton Entrance on Atterbury Street.
items.noteZh: 米尔班克入口关闭至2027年；请从阿特伯里街的曼顿入口进入。

items.name: Tate Modern
items.subtitle: Modern and contemporary art museum
items.why: A free-to-enter museum of modern and contemporary art in a former power station on the South Bank, with the huge Turbine Hall and the underground Tanks. Open late on Fridays and Saturdays.
items.whyZh: 位于南岸前发电站内的现当代艺术博物馆，馆藏陈列免费，有宏大的涡轮大厅和地下的“油罐”空间。周五、周六开放至晚上9点。
items.hours: Sun–Thu 10:00–18:00; Fri–Sat 10:00–21:00 (last entry 30 minutes before closing)
items.hoursZh: 周日至周四 10:00–18:00；周五至周六 10:00–21:00（最后入场为闭馆前30分钟）
items.price: Free entry to the collection; temporary exhibitions are ticketed
items.priceZh: 馆藏陈列免费；临时展览需购票
items.note: Bags larger than cabin-bag size (55 x 40 x 20 cm) are not allowed; lockers are on Level 0 of the Blavatnik Building and do not take cash.
items.noteZh: 超过登机箱尺寸（55 x 40 x 20 厘米）的包不得带入；布拉瓦尼克大楼0层有储物柜，不收现金。

items.name: Cooke Latham Gallery
items.subtitle: Contemporary gallery
items.why: A Battersea gallery in a nineteenth-century warehouse, opened in 2018, showing emerging and mid-career artists, often with large installations. Worth a visit if you are near Battersea Park.
items.whyZh: 位于巴特西、设在十九世纪仓库里的画廊，2018年开放，展出新晋和中生代艺术家，常有大型装置作品。若在巴特西公园附近，值得一访。
items.hoursZh: 展览期间 周三至周五 11:00–17:00
items.note: Other times by arrangement: email the gallery first.
items.noteZh: 其他时间需预约：请先发邮件联系画廊。

items.name: David Zwirner
items.subtitle: Contemporary gallery
items.why: The only London space of a big international gallery, in Mayfair, with changing exhibitions of major living and twentieth-century artists. A short walk from the other Mayfair galleries.
items.whyZh: 一家大型国际画廊在伦敦唯一的展厅，位于梅菲尔，不定期举办在世及二十世纪重要艺术家的展览。离梅菲尔其他画廊都不远。

items.name: DES BAINS
items.subtitle: Contemporary gallery
items.why: A small, minimal gallery near Oxford Circus for emerging artists and experimental work, with shows about borders, movement and belonging. Open Thursday to Saturday.
items.whyZh: 牛津圆环附近的极简风小画廊，面向新晋艺术家和实验性作品，展览常涉及边界、迁移与归属。周四至周六开放。

items.name: LAMB
items.subtitle: Contemporary gallery
items.why: A Mayfair gallery in an early eighteenth-century house, showing British and Latin American artists, with a video programme in the vaults. Its sister business sells furniture and objects by Latin American designers.
items.whyZh: 梅菲尔的画廊，设在一栋十八世纪初的老房子里，展出英国和拉美艺术家的作品，地下室有影像项目。姐妹品牌经营拉美设计师的家具与器物。

items.name: Maureen Paley
items.subtitle: Contemporary gallery
items.why: The larger Bethnal Green space of a long-established contemporary gallery, with solo shows by British and international artists. Its first-floor room at 4 Herald Street is a few minutes' walk away.
items.whyZh: 这家老牌当代艺术画廊在贝思纳尔格林较大的一处展厅，展出英国及国际艺术家的个展。它在 Herald Street 4 号二楼的另一处展厅，步行几分钟即到。

items.name: MMX Gallery
items.subtitle: Photography gallery
items.why: A small photography gallery in a Victorian building on New Cross Road, showing established and emerging photographers. Viewing is currently by appointment only.
items.whyZh: 新十字路上维多利亚时期建筑里的小型摄影画廊，展出成名与新晋摄影师的作品。目前只接受预约参观。
items.note: Open by appointment only; email or phone the gallery before you go.
items.noteZh: 目前仅限预约参观；出发前请先邮件或电话联系画廊。

items.name: Pace Gallery
items.subtitle: Contemporary gallery
items.why: London home of an international gallery, on Hanover Square near Oxford Circus, with exhibitions of modern and contemporary artists.
items.whyZh: 一家国际画廊在伦敦的展厅，位于牛津圆环附近的汉诺威广场，展出现当代艺术家的作品。

items.name: Soft Opening
items.subtitle: Emerging contemporary gallery
items.why: A small Bethnal Green gallery, founded in 2018, that gives emerging artists their first solo shows in London, often with work that mixes materials and media. Step-free access.
items.whyZh: 贝思纳尔格林的小型画廊，2018年创办，常为新锐艺术家在伦敦举办首次个展，作品多混合材料与媒介。无障碍通道。

items.name: Thaddaeus Ropac
items.subtitle: Contemporary gallery
items.why: The London branch of an Austrian-founded international gallery, in Ely House on Dover Street, with changing shows of modern and contemporary artists. Close to the other Mayfair galleries.
items.whyZh: 奥地利人创办的国际画廊的伦敦分馆，设在多佛街的伊利府，不定期举办现当代艺术家的展览。离梅菲尔的其他画廊很近。
items.address: Ely House, 37 Dover St, London W1S 4NJ

items.name: Victoria Miro
items.subtitle: Contemporary gallery
items.why: A large gallery beside the Regent's Canal in Hoxton, showing established and emerging artists across two exhibition spaces. Free to enter.
items.whyZh: 位于霍克斯顿摄政运河边的大型画廊，两个展厅同时展出知名与新晋艺术家的作品。免费入场。
items.hours: Tue–Sat 10:00–18:00; closed Sun, Mon and public holidays
items.hoursZh: 周二至周六 10:00–18:00；周日、周一及公共假日闭馆

items.name: White Cube Mason's Yard
items.subtitle: Contemporary gallery
items.why: A free, two-floor gallery in a courtyard in St James's, opened in 2006, showing contemporary artists. Both floors have lift access.
items.whyZh: 圣詹姆斯一处庭院里的免费两层画廊，2006年开放，展出当代艺术家的作品。两层均有电梯。
items.hours: Tue, Wed, Fri, Sat 10:00–18:00; closed Mon, Thu, Sun
items.hoursZh: 周二、周三、周五、周六 10:00–18:00；周一、周四、周日闭馆

items.name: 180 Studios
items.subtitle: Creative and exhibition centre
items.why: A Brutalist building on the Strand turned into a creative centre that opens to the public for large, ticketed installations and shows. It also has restaurants and cafés.
items.whyZh: 河岸街上的粗野主义建筑，如今改造成创意中心，向公众开放大型售票装置展和演出，楼内还有餐厅和咖啡馆。
items.note: Shows are ticketed with timed slots, so book online. Ryoji Ikeda's data-cosm [n°1] runs until 20 December 2026.
items.noteZh: 展览按时段售票，请在线预约。池田亮司的 data-cosm [n°1] 展至2026年12月20日。

items.name: Copeland Gallery
items.subtitle: Project space and exhibition hall
items.why: A large gallery space inside Copeland Park in Peckham, used for exhibitions such as the annual Peckham 24 art and photography shows, as well as markets and events. Check what is on before you go, as it is event-led.
items.whyZh: 佩卡姆科普兰公园内的大型展览空间，用于举办每年的“Peckham 24”艺术与摄影展，也承办市集和活动。以活动为主，出发前请先查看当前展出。
items.address: Unit 9I, Copeland Park, 133 Copeland Rd, London SE15 3SN
items.note: No fixed opening hours; open for listed exhibitions and events only.
items.noteZh: 没有固定开放时间；仅在展览和活动期间开放。

items.name: Curzon Bloomsbury
items.subtitle: Independent cinema
items.why: A six-screen cinema in the Brunswick Centre showing new releases and arthouse films, near Russell Square. One screen, Bertha DocHouse, is dedicated to documentaries.
items.whyZh: 位于布伦瑞克中心的六厅影院，放映新片和艺术电影，靠近罗素广场。其中一厅“Bertha DocHouse”专映纪录片。
